articles.title: Android app developers will soon have to share their address publicly
articles.short_snippet: Independent Android app developers are worried about their privacy after Google announced that from next year many of them will be required to share a phone number and address publicly. The policy change is intended to meet European Union regulations under the Digital Services Act, but Google says contact details will be made public worldwide. […]

articles.short_snippet: US District Judge Loren AliKhan has blocked the Federal Communications Commission from conducting an early review of ABC's broadcast licenses in a preliminary injunction, and rejected its efforts to dismiss ABC's First Amendment lawsuit. ABC has accused the FCC of violating its free speech rights and claims the agency "waged a retaliatory campaign" against the […]

articles.short_snippet: Black Friday isn’t just a good time to save on a new TV but also a chance to spend less on what you watch on it. The shopping holiday often brings steep streaming discounts, and this year is no exception, with some streamers offering more than 50 percent off. HBO Max, Apple TV, and Hulu […]

articles.title: SpaceX million-satellite plan exposes hurdles to space-based data centers
articles.short_snippet: The US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has approved SpaceX's plan to deploy one million space-based data center satellites, paving the way for AI infrastructure to extend beyond Earth.

articles.title: DIGITIMES Insight: KV cache growth will not translate one-for-one into CXL memory demand
articles.short_snippet: The rapid growth of KV cache in AI inference will not translate proportionally into demand for CXL memory, because host DRAM usually takes the data moved out of HBM first, according to DIGITIMES. CXL becomes necessary only when host DRAM is constrained, the data is worth reusing, and the service depends on reloading it quickly.

articles.title: Can AI resist temptation? Anthropic finds lower violation rates in new Claude models
articles.short_snippet: Anthropic has used simulated tests to assess whether artificial intelligence (AI) can resist temptation and follow rules. The results found that its new-generation Claude models still attempted to cross boundaries, but violations involving the use of external data fell substantially.

articles.title: Analog IC shortages persist despite AI uncertainty as supply becomes key concern for 2027
articles.short_snippet: Market concerns over circular financing in AI remain unresolved following the turmoil surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation on November 12 and subsequent return. Supply chain players across AI chips, memory, and power-related sectors could all be affected, fueling uncertainty over the broader AI outlook.

articles.title: US chip rules, anti-distillation efforts force delays on China's flagship AI models
articles.short_snippet: A coordinated push by Washington and leading American artificial intelligence labs is beginning to bottleneck China's rapid AI progress. articles.title: Samsung chip fabs could deploy over 10,000 robots by 2030
articles.short_snippet: The number of robots operating in Samsung Electronics' semiconductor facilities could rise from about 100 in 2026 to more than 10,000 by 2030 as the South Korean chipmaker seeks to automate tasks that still require human labor.

articles.title: TSMC lifts pure-play foundry share to 75% as sector grows 36% in third quarter
articles.short_snippet: TSMC's hold on the pure-play foundry market tightened further in the third quarter of 2026, as the AI-driven upturn continued to reward the market leader more than its rivals. articles.title: Samsung bolsters M&A team as it eyes robotics, AI
articles.short_snippet: Samsung Electronics is strengthening its mergers and acquisitions (M&A) operations as it seeks growth in robotics, artificial intelligence (AI), and data center cooling to offset weakness in its consumer electronics businesses.

articles.title: Exclusive: Oxford-based LUX bets on 3D heat-exchanger geometry to break AI data center cooling limits
articles.short_snippet: As AI data centers push toward ever-denser racks, cooling is becoming a problem measured not only in megawatts, but in kilograms and cubic meters.

articles.title: 84 million GDDR7 chips at stake: Nvidia's RTX Pro 5500 China cancellations test Samsung, SK Hynix
articles.short_snippet: Nvidia's push into China's AI market has stalled. That adds uncertainty to the GDDR7 demand growth Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix had been counting on.

articles.title: EmBestor's earnings soar 15-fold on the memory rally, but its real bet is industrial AI
articles.short_snippet: EmBestor Technology makes industrial-grade flash memory and data storage products. Higher memory prices drove its revenue and gross margin to record levels. For the first three quarters of 2026, it reported revenue of NT$841 million (approx. US$26 million), a gross margin of 58.52% and after-tax earnings per share (EPS) of NT$8.21.

articles.title: China's year-end cash crunch sparks a memory fire sale — Samsung, SK Hynix hold the line on contract prices
articles.short_snippet: After a rapid surge, memory prices had split into two tiers by late 2026. The industry describes the market as "fat at the top, thin at the bottom." Upstream suppliers are still highly profitable, and their capacity still falls short of demand. Consumer electronics, by contrast, are in a slump. articles.title: Kyocera targets JPY2.6 trillion revenue by fiscal 2031, bets on AI components, solutions growth
articles.short_snippet: Kyocera plans to increase revenue to JPY2.6 trillion (US$16.3 billion) and more than double operating profit to JPY320 billion by the fiscal year ending March 2031, as the Japanese electronics manufacturer steps up investment in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure components, semiconductor processing equipment, and next-generation mobility products.

articles.title: Samsung revamps memory R&D in custom HBM push
articles.short_snippet: Samsung Electronics is streamlining its memory development operations and setting up a dedicated logic design team as it seeks to expand its presence in the market for customized high-bandwidth memory (HBM) used in AI accelerators.

articles.title: Huawei's Tau EDA fixes China's real chip design weakness — tools that never worked together
articles.short_snippet: Huawei and a group of Chinese electronic design automation (EDA) vendors say they have built China's first interoperable domestic EDA toolchain. Called Tau EDA, it is designed for chips made under Huawei's Tau Scaling Law. The chain targets the main weakness of China's chip design software sector: its tools worked well on their own but could not work together.

articles.title: Column: Robot precision components, bottlenecks
articles.short_snippet: A robot's joints do not all use the same motors and reducers. Each joint is built around its load, speed, and precision requirements. Before looking at the key components and bottlenecks for each type of robot, this installment outlines what the most important components do and how they differ.

articles.title: Taiwan seeks to lock in 15% US tariff to shield AI server and chip exports
articles.short_snippet: Taiwan's government is confident the US will set its final tariff rate on Taiwanese goods at 15%, Vice Premier Li-chiun Cheng said, after the Office of the US Trade Representative (USTR) released the findings of its latest Section 301 investigation.

articles.title: Musk, SpaceX pledge two shares for every US child's Trump Account
articles.short_snippet: Elon Musk's pledge to give every American child two SpaceX shares, worth close to US$18 billion, could make tens of millions of children shareholders in his space and AI company. But SpaceX's own announcement ties the gift to active Trump Accounts, and some analysts see publicity as much as philanthropy.

articles.title: MediaTek confirms 2027 flagship mobile SoC launch, dismisses cancellation rumors
articles.short_snippet: MediaTek has denied market rumors that it may not launch a Dimensity 9700 flagship smartphone system-on-chip (SoC) in 2027, saying development of its next Dimensity flagship has not been interrupted and that a new flagship SoC will arrive in 2027 as originally planned.

articles.title: US Section 301 tariffs spare key chip markets, but Vietnam clouds Taiwan's 2027 outlook
articles.short_snippet: The Office of the US Trade Representative (USTR) released the findings of its Section 301 investigation into "structural overcapacity" on November 25, 2026, US Eastern time, proposing additional tariffs on 14 economies, including Taiwan, China, the European Union, Japan, and South Korea.

articles.title: Transtouch targets aerospace, memory to drive 2027 growth
articles.short_snippet: Niche touch-panel maker Transtouch Technology returned to profit in the first three quarters of 2026, posting earnings per share of NT$0.87 (US$0.03) against a loss of NT$6.78 million a year earlier, helped by a better product mix and its strategic investment in memory module maker E-plux Electronic.

articles.title: Kioxia, Nvidia test SSDs as petabyte-scale extension of GPU memory
articles.short_snippet: Kioxia is testing with Nvidia whether solid-state drives can take on part of the work of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) in AI servers, a move that would give the Japanese flash maker a larger role in a memory market led by South Korean suppliers.

articles.title: Tatung secures 345 kV transformer order in US, lands first modular AIDC turnkey project
articles.short_snippet: Tatung has secured orders for 345kV large transformers in Texas and California and won its first turnkey edge AI data center order, the company said at its joint investor conference for the third quarter of 2026 on November 26. It named power, computing and land as its three main growth drivers.

articles.title: Etron chairman urges Taiwan sovereign AI fund, dismisses 2027 economic concerns
articles.short_snippet: Etron Technology chairman Nicky Lu called on Taiwan's academia and industry to draw up a sovereign AI development plan and set up a Taiwan sovereign AI fund to build an independent AI hardware and software ecosystem and edge AI systems, dismissing concerns about the 2027 economy despite recent swings in the global AI market. She renewed US curbs on AI chip exports to China.

articles.title: EU's EUR50 billion tech fund targets the missing link between research and industrial scale
articles.short_snippet: As technological advances accelerate and the urgency around technological sovereignty ripples across industries worldwide, Europe is intensifying its push into strategic technology sectors to narrow the competitive gap with the US and China.

articles.title: Huawei pitches Ascend AI chips to South Korean customers
articles.short_snippet: Huawei Technologies has begun marketing its self-developed Ascend AI chips in South Korea, seeking a foothold in a market where Nvidia is expanding its business through partnerships with domestic chipmakers.

articles.title: US battery startups find a second wind as Washington weighs funding revival
articles.short_snippet: Among the industrial-policy changes anticipated following the US midterm elections is a potential revival of federal funding aimed at stimulating the domestic energy-technology supply chain amid growing concerns over China's entrenched dominance in critical battery materials.
